knowledge_base: `app/main.py` currently defines `_normalize_operation(method: str, path: str) -> str` and uses it inside `audit_logging_middleware` to populate `audit_record['operation']`.

`app/api/story_development.py` exposes dynamic detail routes including `GET /v1/story-development/decisions/{node_id}`, `GET /v1/story-development/review/findings/{finding_id}`, `GET /v1/story-development/review/inspect-links/{link_id}`, `GET /v1/story-development/characters/{character_id}`, `GET /v1/story-development/characters/{character_id}/relationships`, `GET /v1/story-development/world-bible/{entry_type}/{title}`, and `GET /v1/story-development/branches/{branch_id}/state-refs`.
The merge review identified that the current story-development branch in `_normalize_operation` joins remaining path segments and therefore produces high-cardinality operations for detail routes.

operation_requirements: `operation` must be stable across different ids or titles for the same route family.
`operation` must not include live `character_id`, `finding_id`, `link_id`, `node_id`, `branch_id`, `entry_type`, or world-bible `title` values.
status_code_expectations: The middleware still must not fail the request if audit-log writing fails.

expected_outcomes: Calling `_normalize_operation('GET', '/v1/story-development/characters/test-character-id')` no longer returns a string containing `test-character-id`.
Calling `_normalize_operation('GET', '/v1/story-development/review/findings/test-finding-id')` no longer returns a string containing `test-finding-id`.
Existing stable operations like `job.create`, `job.status.read`, and `story_development.drafting.draft_artifacts.read` are preserved.
